name: Geisler Electric
old_description: At Geisler Electric, you can trust us to treat you like family and to do a great job by providing a quick response to your call. We will send a clean, courteous, and reliable service professional that fixes your problem RIGHT the first time, all at a guaranteed price. Geisler Electric is the most on-time and efficient electrical contractor in the area – guaranteed! We’re proud to be the top electrical contractors in Kansas City, KS and the surrounding areas.
about:
Geisler Electric is a family-owned electrical contractor based in Manhattan, Kansas. The company was founded in 2013 by Joe Geisler, who serves as owner and electrician, and has since expanded its service area to include the Kansas City metropolitan region.

The firm provides a range of electrical installation, troubleshooting, and upgrade services for residential, commercial, and industrial clients. Its offerings include residential and commercial wiring, panel change-outs, security systems, home networking, EV charging stations, smart lighting control, generator installation, and integrated smart-home technology such as audio/video and home theater systems. Technicians operate out of fully stocked service trucks, enabling most repairs to be completed in a single visit. The company maintains regular weekday hours and offers 24/7 emergency response.

Geisler Electric serves homeowners, businesses, and industrial facilities in Manhattan and the surrounding Kansas City area. Past customers include an industrial processing facility that required immediate electrical corrections, as well as residential clients needing dryer outlet repairs, kitchen remodels, and whole-home generator installations.

The company emphasizes its family-owned structure, promising to treat clients like neighbors and to provide guaranteed pricing and on-time service. Its differentiators include round-the-clock emergency availability, Kansas-licensed electricians, and a commitment to completing jobs correctly on the first visit.

name: Gellco Work Outfitters
old_description: Gellco Clothing & Shoes is Oklahoma’s leading provider of Safety Footwear. With over 20 name brands and well over 200 different styles in-stock we offer by far the largest selection in the great state of Oklahoma. Gellco offers safety footwear in just about any style, category, safety feature, and price range imaginable. We know that Safety Footwear is not a one size fits all.
about:
Founded in 1959 in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, Gellco Clothing & Shoes began as a retailer of occupational footwear and work apparel for the American worker. The company has remained privately held and expanded to five brick-and-mortar locations across Oklahoma City, Edmond, Broken Arrow, and Tulsa.

Today Gellco operates as a distributor and service provider for safety footwear, flame-resistant clothing, and workwear accessories. It stocks more than 20 name brands and over 200 styles in its stores, and deploys a fleet of six mobile shoe trucks that carry upwards of 1,000 pairs directly to job sites at no extra charge. A central shipping center in Oklahoma enables delivery to most U.S. destinations within three to five business days. The company also manages corporate programs that include customized online catalogs, flexible invoicing, reporting, payroll deduction, and custom embroidery for logos.

Gellco serves industrial and corporate customers ranging from small crews of five to workforces of 5,000 employees. Its client base spans sectors that require OSHA-compliant protective footwear and flame-resistant garments, such as construction, energy, manufacturing, and utilities. The staff is trained on OSHA PPE standards and assists with product selection for specific work environments.

The company differentiates itself through its breadth of inventory, mobile service convenience, and a service model that emphasizes personal customer support. Gellco’s corporate programs are tailored to each account, with proactive communication on backorders and alternative product suggestions to keep crews equipped.

name: Generac Power Systems
old_description: Manufactures backup generators and power equipment for residential and industrial customers.
about:
Generac Power Systems is headquartered in Waukesha, Wisconsin, where it was founded in 1959. The company began as the first to engineer affordable home standby generators and developed the first engine purpose‑built for generator use. No founder names or ownership structure (family, veteran, woman‑owned) are disclosed in public sources.

Today Generac manufactures the widest range of power products in the marketplace, spanning portable, residential, commercial, and industrial generators. It also designs and builds manual and fully automatic transfer switches for backup power applications up to 2 MW. The Generac Mobile line adds light towers, trailer‑mounted mobile generators, and combination units for demanding environments. The company pioneered the residential power washer category and now offers a full line of power washers, pressure washers, water pumps, solar battery storage systems, and smart home energy management platforms. Facility size, headcount, and annual production volumes are not publicly specified.

Generac serves homeowners through a network of authorized dealers, as well as commercial and industrial customers in sectors such as construction, mobile power, and renewable energy. Its products are used for home backup power, job‑site lighting and power, commercial facility backup, and off‑grid solar storage.

The company cites its early innovations — first affordable home standby generator, first dedicated generator engine — and its position as the #1 manufacturer of home backup generators as key differentiators. It also emphasizes the breadth of its product portfolio, leadership in transfer switches up to 2 MW, and a commitment to sustainability outlined in its 2025 Sustainability & Impact Report.

name: General Transformer Corporation
old_description: Custom transformer and magnetics manufacturer based and manufacturing entirely in Wylie, Texas since 1976.
about:
General Transformer Corporation has operated from Wylie, Texas since 1976. The company was founded as a custom transformer and magnetics manufacturer and has remained at the same location for nearly five decades.

The company designs and builds custom transformers, inductors, chokes, line conditioners, and related magnetics for industrial applications. Its capabilities include custom design and engineering, in-house coil winding, and an ISO 9001:2015 quality system. With a staff of 2–10 employees, the firm handles orders ranging from prototype units to production runs of thousands, all manufactured at its Texas facility.

Primary markets include traffic control systems, oil and gas, and general industrial sectors. The company serves OEM customers globally, shipping a significant portion of its output internationally while maintaining domestic production.

General Transformer emphasizes its "Optimum Design" philosophy, which tailors each magnetic component to the exact application rather than adapting off‑the‑shelf designs. It highlights U.S. manufacturing, a large material inventory for quick turnaround, automated testing with LABView software, barcode serialization, and decades‑long customer relationships as key differentiators.

name: General Woodcraft Inc
old_description: Founded in 1949, General Woodcraft has a proud heritage of quality that we think is evident in the projects you see throughout this site. Our many clients, architects, designers, builders, contractors and discerning homeowners, and their projects, speak to the professional performance – on time and within budget – which we consistently deliver.
about:
General Woodcraft Inc. was founded in 1949 in New London, Connecticut. The company began as a woodworking shop serving local builders and has grown into a supplier of custom millwork and a broad inventory of domestic and exotic hardwoods.

The firm operates a custom woodworking and architectural millwork facility producing custom mouldings, mantels, countertops, and wooden boat parts. It also stocks marine-grade plywood, a wide range of figured and exotic lumber, bamboo, and hardwood plywood. General Woodcraft is the exclusive North American distributor of Mataverde premium Ipe decking and the Climate-Shield rain screen system, and offers the Eurotec deck system and Trespa Pura NFC panels.

Its customers include architects, designers, contractors, and homeowners across the woodworking, marine, and construction industries. Notable projects include supplying teak for the U.S. Coast Guard barque Eagle and the Mystic Seaport Museum's Joseph Conrad, as well as decking for the Treasure Island Casino in Las Vegas and the Clinton Presidential Library in Little Rock.

The company emphasizes a set of operating principles called TRACC — Trust, Respect, Attitude, Communication, and Consistency — and states a commitment to environmentally responsible sourcing through sustained-yield forestry practices.

name: Generations Millwork
old_description: We have been proudly serving all of your custom fixture needs in Oklahoma since 1990. Greet your visitors with our unique custom-designed doors. Get in touch with us today to find the type of door you're looking for.
about:
Generation III, operating as Generations Millwork, is a family-owned carpentry and millwork shop based in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The company was founded in April 1990 by Chuck Clowers, initially working as carpenters and home builders. Their first project was a large home in Oakdale Farms, after which they opened a dedicated shop to focus on cabinetry, furniture, and trim work.

The shop produces custom cabinetry, furniture, doors, mantels, wine cellars, tables, closet and media units, and other millwork. Residential projects account for roughly 50% of business, commercial cabinetry for 30%, and creative specialty pieces for the remaining 20%. Work ranges from full custom homes to individual bathroom vanities, pergolas, and entry gates. The company has also completed interior fit-outs for custom coaches, buses, yachts, and train cars. Commercial projects have included banks and law offices spanning 1,500 to 15,000 square feet.

Clients include residential homeowners, commercial developers, and owners of luxury vehicles and vessels. The firm has served banks, law offices, and private clients seeking custom interiors for coaches, buses, yachts, and rail cars.

The company emphasizes problem-solving, service, creativity, and maintaining the highest standard of quality. It backs its work with warranties and a satisfaction guarantee, drawing on over 38 years of experience.

old_description: My name is Jarrett Maxwell and I am the artist, designer, and craftsman behind Geometric Innovations LLC. I founded Geometric Innovations in 2009 as a general home remodel company. about:
Geometric Innovations LLC is based in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The company was founded in 2009 by Jarrett Maxwell, who began as a general home remodeler before narrowing his focus to fine woodworking, custom furniture, and cabinetry.

Today the shop produces custom furniture, cabinetry for new construction and remodels, and a range of millwork. Maxwell works as the sole designer and craftsman, collaborating with private clients, interior designers, and architects on residential and commercial projects. Past work includes bedroom sets, credenzas, china cabinets, tables, lamps, mirror frames, built-ins, entertainment centers, hidden bookcases, kitchen cabinets, and bathroom vanities.

The business serves the residential and commercial construction sectors, as well as the interior design and architecture professions. Clients range from homeowners seeking one-of-a-kind pieces to design professionals specifying custom millwork for larger projects.

Maxwell describes his approach as blurring the line between art and furniture, emphasizing geometry-inspired forms that balance masculine angles with feminine curves. He cites a commitment to excellence in design, materials, construction, and client relationships as the guiding principle behind the company.

name: George T. Hall Company
old_description: 90+ year manufacturer of UL-certified custom control panels
about:
George T. Hall Company (GTH) was founded in 1932 in Anaheim, California, by George Hall. For nearly a century the firm has operated under the motto "The House That Service Built." Today the business is led by Chairman Chuck Niemann and President Dina Johnson, with an executive team that includes a U.S. Navy veteran serving as technical manager in the Reno panel shop.

GTH manufactures custom UL‑certified control panels (UL 508A and UL 698A) in two dedicated panel shops located in California and Nevada. The company provides full‑service control solutions that span design, programming, instrumentation, control panel manufacturing, field services, system integration, and product distribution. As a CSIA‑certified system integrator since 2017, GTH modernizes legacy automation, delivers PLC and SCADA programming, and supports the full lifecycle of industrial control systems from commissioning through preventive maintenance.

The company serves public and private industrial customers across the western United States. Its industry portfolio includes water and wastewater, mining/minerals/metals, food and beverage, pharmaceutical and life sciences, general manufacturing, and aerospace. For mining projects GTH deploys MSHA‑ and BROWZ‑certified engineers; for food and beverage it applies ISA‑ and FDA‑aligned expertise; and for pharmaceutical clients it provides traceable PLC/SCADA systems that meet strict regulatory requirements.

GTH differentiates itself by combining panel fabrication, integration, field service, and distribution under one roof, reducing handoffs and accelerating project timelines. Its quality management system is certified to ISO 9001:2015 by DQS, and the firm emphasizes a culture of continuous improvement rooted in its founding service legacy. A recent white paper highlighted the ability to reuse up to 95 % of existing PLC code during SCADA migrations, preserving customer investment while lowering risk.

name: Gilbert Creek Woodworks
old_description: With decades of experience in the industry and proven methods, Gilbert Creek Woodworks is a premier provider of custom wood products, including kitchen cabinets, office furniture, entertainment centers, architectural millwork, and other specialty wood pieces. We make beautiful wood products that significantly enhance lives through exceptional communication, design, and manufacturing.
about:
Gilbert Creek Woodworks was founded in 1987 by Duane Zweber in Menomonie, Wisconsin. After 30 years as a production manager and head of product design for two large woodworking firms, Zweber established his own shop to produce custom wood products. The business remains family-run, with his sons Brian and Robert now involved in finishing and operations.

The company designs, manufactures, and finishes a range of custom woodwork, including kitchen cabinets, office furniture, entertainment centers, and architectural millwork. All production is handled in-house, from initial design through final finishing, allowing the team to control quality on each piece.

Gilbert Creek serves both residential and commercial clients, producing pieces for individual homeowners as well as businesses seeking custom office environments. Duane Zweber’s background includes projects for individuals and companies around the world, and the company’s website highlights work for homes, businesses, and special projects.

The firm emphasizes communication, design, and manufacturing as its core differentiators, describing its approach as a “better way of building things.” Brian Zweber’s specialized training at the National Institute of Wood Finishing adds expertise in finish trends and creative finishing solutions.
